commitResults.messageTitle: Completed rename, greet, exit; updated .gitignore for .class files
Added user input echo and exit
Added user task list: task add and list print
Added ability to mark/unmark tasks as complete via Task class
Add minimum implementations of task types
Add support for tracking todo, deadline, event tasks
Add TaskList class to handle task operations
Add minimal error handling; input parsing separated into own method
Add support for deleting tasks from TaskList
Create temp enum for commands, yet to integrate with rest of program
Add initial save file creation and file read
commitResults.messageBody:
Curret version of file read is untested

File read implementation requires new file corruption exception,
this is bundled together with the commit

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for saving and updating tasks in file
commitResults.messageBody:
Update existing tasks happens for mark, unmark, delete;
this involves rewriting the entire file in O(N) time

This resolves complexities with random access read/write,
hinging on users not ballooning save file size

Task, TaskList, and relevant task subclasses updated with
method to convert to an easily parsable string for saving

.gitignore updated accordingly to ignore save file that
contains test contents

commitResults.messageBody: Contains functionality for saving task list to hard disk

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for LocalDate; save read bug found
commitResults.messageBody:
Minimal implementation of date formatting into a more
readable version completed

Bug is line 50 in Ayre.java, will be dealt with at a
later stage; it duplicates the current save file contents
when loading it at startup

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-8'
Abstract file IO into its own class
Minor fix to remove excess save log line breaks
Add argument validation to Command enum
commitResults.messageBody:
The Command enum should handle arg validation to ensure
command line input truly matches the command via its
requirements of the args

Additional helper class ValidationTools created to hold
various methods of validation and also to hide patterns
and formats from the rest of the code

New exception reflects the validation error more closely

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace Scanner with BufferedReader
commitResults.messageBody:
Done in preparation for implementing parser to tokenize
user input

commitResults.messageTitle: Add more relevant command-related exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
A bit of a half-baked commit to quickly
synchronize progress across devices

commitResults.messageTitle: Add EnumMap-based input parse and execute
commitResults.messageBody:
Parse and execute functionality implemented mostly with new
Parser, ParsedInput, CommandExecutor, and CommandResult classes,
with a trivial method added to LiveTaskList to get number of tasks
for additional argument validation purposes

Some functionality like replies to user commands have been lost
with removal of the old parser, expected to be added back in later
commits with addition of ui class

Minor validation logic changes to Command to better reflect how
user input is checked (check whether entered value is valid integer
rather than is strictly positive integer)

This also results in a bundled change to ValidationTools used
by Command

commitResults.messageTitle: Move input scan and console output to UI class
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandResult has been updated to carry the reply
message relevant to the command executed, on top of the
old TERMINATE/CONTINUE statuses; as a result, the enum
has been renamed more aptly to AyreStatus

With the new implementation, message reply info now bubbles
up from the location where the command-relevant method was
actually executed:
eg. Task -> TaskList -> LiveTaskList -> CommandExecutor -> Ayre

For this, LiveTaskList was updated to use a transformer from
TaskList to String, so that the message can be passed on

commitResults.messageTitle: Update UI flavour text
commitResults.messageBody:
Some cleanup to better centralize printing logic with the UI class

This is done in preparation for consolidating the custom exceptions
and implementing them beyond basic placeholder messages

commitResults.messageTitle: Add safety check to clean up temp file
commitResults.messageBody:
In case Files.move() throws an IOException, this is caught and
the temp file is deleted while the exception is thrown further
to be dealt with at a later stage

commitResults.messageBody:

reorganize into packages before fully fleshing out exception handling

Minimal Gradle set up
commitResults.messageBody:
Modifications to Ayre.java and build.gradle to enforce output
encoding as UTF-8

commitResults.messageTitle: Change data-ferrying classes to records
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandResult and ParsedInput are both trivial classes with the
sole purpose of transferring immutable data (that cannot otherwise
be grouped together easily) across classes

Hence it is not only fitting but helpful to change them to records,
with the default-added record .equals() being useful for unit testing

clamping stdout to UTF-8

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for FIND command
commitResults.messageBody:
Added a new method to Task class to support this search by directly
checking against this.name rather than the toString() of the task

This prevents foul play by naming tasks as a date
